parameters.query:
SELECT id, email, full_name, company, step, last_sent_at, created_at
FROM outreach_leads
WHERE status = 'active'
  AND step < 4
  AND (last_sent_at IS NULL OR last_sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 days')
LIMIT 50;
UPDATE outreach_leads SET step = {{ $json.nextStep }}, last_sent_at = NOW(), status = CASE WHEN {{ $json.nextStep }} >= 4 THEN 'exhausted' ELSE 'active' END WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}';

meta.note: Tablo: outreach_leads(id, email, full_name, company, step INT default 0, last_sent_at, status, created_at). Günde 50 mail limit — spam riskine karşı.
